token_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password='kWuKkrH')
access_token = token_resp['access_token']

# Gather all playlists in library
page_index=0
page_limit=20
playlists=[]
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Gather unique song ids from playlists
song_ids=set()
for p in playlists:
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    for s in pl.get('songs', []):
        song_ids.add(s['id'])

# Determine reggae songs + artists (genre == 'reggae')
reggae_song_rows=[]
reggae_artist_map={}  # id -> name
for sid in sorted(song_ids):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    if (song.get('genre') or '').lower() == 'reggae':
        artists = song.get('artists', [])
        reggae_song_rows.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': song.get('title'),
            'artist_ids': [a['id'] for a in artists],
            'artist_names': [a['name'] for a in artists],
        })
        for a in artists:
            reggae_artist_map[a['id']] = a['name']

reggae_artist_ids = sorted(reggae_artist_map.keys())
print('reggae_song_count', len(reggae_song_rows))
print('target_artist_count', len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('target_artist_ids', reggae_artist_ids)
print('target_artist_names', [reggae_artist_map[i] for i in reggae_artist_ids])

# Fetch all currently following artists to compute delta
following=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    following.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

following_ids = sorted({a['artist_id'] for a in following})
print('currently_following_count', len(following_ids))
print('currently_following_ids', following_ids)

need_ids = [aid for aid in reggae_artist_ids if aid not in set(following_ids)]
already_ids = [aid for aid in reggae_artist_ids if aid in set(following_ids)]
print('already_in_target_state', already_ids, len(already_ids))
print('need_action', need_ids, len(need_ids))
print('need_action_names', [reggae_artist_map[i] for i in need_ids])
